title: MedPAO-Assist: Edge-Deployable, Modality-Aware Agentic AI for Radiology Report Structuring
authors: Shrish Shrinath Vaidya, Minmini Selvam, Ganapathy Krishnamurthi

one_line_essence: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26913，Comments 为 'accepted at MICCAI Workshop Agentic AI for Medicine, 2026'）：MedPAO-Assist 的稀缺性不在效果而在部署成本——整条流水线跑在 0.6B 级 SLM 上，'requiring only ~3.3 GB peak RAM and achieving an average end-to-end latency of ~31 seconds on a standard laptop CPU through an asynchronous, multi-threaded execution pipeline'，且 'no external API calls, or internet connectivity'。架构是 Extract-Ground-Generate：概念抽取 → SNOMED-CT 本体对齐 → 结构化报告生成，再加一个 'speech-driven human-in-the-loop correction phase'，作者称 'among the earliest agentic systems to run its entire pipeline with a Small Language Model (SLM) in the 0.6B-parameter range'。价值路由：迁移价值有两处一是 '0.6B SLM + 3.3GB RAM + CPU' 这条成本线给了 'agent 不必上大模型' 的第二个实测锚点（昨日 Agima 是环境侧证据，今天是业务侧）；二是 'human-in-the-loop correction' 被做成语音驱动的最后一环，即把人工修正放在管道末端而不是让 agent 自行冒险——这与 Lean 4 repair 那篇 '失败即反馈' 是同一思想的两种形态。证据边界必须写清：作者自述 'evaluate each pipeline stage individually'，未给出与开源大模型 / 云端方案的端到端准确率对照数字，'no-touch workflow' 与四种模态（Chest X-ray / Chest CT / Abdomen CT / Brain MRI）的效果无第三方复现；MICCAI workshop 论文。代码 / 项目页：待核验/暂无。
